target_rule: constant 24h mean of frozen shared baseline; not target observations

manifest.normalization: train-only affine, shared BM/WM; no held-out rescaling
manifest.evidence: in-sample development fit with realized prices/temperature

audit.gap_policy: Training-only time interpolation and boundary fill; demand fit/scoring use measured hours only; prices must be complete.

gap_handling.scope: training window only; aggregate demand and temperature
gap_handling.scoring: measured demand hours only; baseline, BM and WM share the same mask
gap_handling.wm_reconstruction: interpolated demand; QP transitions across missing hourly endpoints excluded

initialization.forecast: carry training terminal state, no reset
initialization.neutral_coordinate: 1-2x=F0; neutral coordinate convention, distinct physical states

manifest.bm_solver: scalar BM1 RK4, restart held price each hour, no state clipping
manifest.wm_solver: existing qp_params and discrete deterministic WM4

coverage.gap_policy: Training-only time interpolation and boundary fill; demand fit/scoring use measured hours only; prices must be complete.

provenance.compatibility: LF/CRLF normalization; reviewed WM4 H5-only change if present

development_policy.rule: prefer linear within 1% of best checked development MSE; include numerical error and diagnose identification
development_policy.evidence: development choice only; no statistical significance or causal-response claim

provenance.selection: unselected DEVELOPMENT candidate; no final-test claim

provenance.wm_validation_addition: r_F+r_U>=r_R-tol; frozen r satisfies it; no dynamics change
provenance.price_response_primary: newer selected S3 only analytic; unmatched WM origin
provenance.raw_demand_unit: original aggregate units; point/interval semantics unresolved
provenance.raw_price_unit: DKK/MWh DK1 spot proxy, not verified retail tariff
